_comment: Sample MCP config sections for the BrowserOS neo stdio bridge. Use the section that matches your client. Replace <path-to-browser-mcp-bridge> with the full path to the folder you placed this bridge in (e.g. C:\Users\<you>\Documents\browser-mcp-bridge). Transport is STDIO (command: node) — do NOT point clients at the HTTP URL directly; Electron clients get 403 'unsupported request' from neo's anti-browser guard, which is the whole reason this bridge exists.

chatbox._comment: Chatbox: add this object to the settings.mcp.servers array in %APPDATA%\xyz.chatboxapp.app\config.json (or create the entry via the MCP UI — Chatbox will add its own 'id' UUID). Shape verified working on Windows 2026-08-26.

generic_mcpServers._comment: Standard .mcp.json / claude_desktop_config.json / most other clients: mcpServers map keyed by server name.

notes.transport_type: stdio (the bridge is the stdio side; it forwards to neo over HTTP internally)

alternatives.http://127.0.0.1:9010/mcp: local proxy port — also verified working

notes.prerequisite: BrowserOS neo (claw) server running on the same machine; no auth token needed for the local endpoint
notes.verify: cd <bridge folder> && node bridge-test.mjs   → expect 'ALL PASSED' + 20 tools
